recognize_zh: 低倍薄層血片中，在大量大小正常的紅血球之間只見一個香蕉形／新月形的寄生蟲，中央有聚集的深色染色質與色素，兩端較尖，這種新月形配子體指向惡性瘧原蟲（P. falciparum）；倍率較低，雌雄分型僅供參考。
features: Single crescent/banana-shaped gametocyte among numerous normal-sized red cells
Central compact dark chromatin with pigment granules
Relatively slender body with tapering ends, favoring a female macrogametocyte
Host red cell outline largely inapparent
Low magnification limits evaluation of fine chromatin detail; no ring forms clearly seen
describe_en: Thin blood smear at low magnification shows a single crescent-shaped gametocyte with centrally aggregated dark chromatin and pigment lying among normal-sized red cells. The body is slender with tapered ends, a configuration usually attributed to the female macrogametocyte, although sex determination is unreliable at this magnification. No ring forms are clearly identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a Plasmodium falciparum gametocyte.

ddx.vs: Microgametocytes are broader and sausage-shaped with more diffuse chromatin and pigment, whereas macrogametocytes are slender with compact central chromatin.
P. vivax gametocytes are round and fill an enlarged red cell with Schüffner stippling rather than being crescentic.
Trypanosomes are extracellular with a flagellum and kinetoplast, while artifacts lack organized chromatin and pigment.
